**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted (subscription terms) |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted (shipping policy) |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unsupported** |
| "Tea that's easy to stop and start" | Soft framing, backed by the pause/cancel claim. Fine. |

**Problem:** "most boxes ship free" implies that most orders pass £25. No order data in the policy supports that, so it's an invented statistic. It also says "boxes", while the policy describes tins and tea bags. The free delivery claim is true only with the £25 threshold, and the "most" wording blurs that.

**Voice and slop:** No banned words, no em-dashes, no exclamation marks. Tone is plain and warm.

**Suggested fix:**
> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

As with all public content, Sam needs to approve it before it goes out.
